ruleDefinitions.name: HTML Help HH.EXE Suspicious Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious child process of a Microsoft HTML Help (HH.exe)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\CertReq\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\CertUtil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\installutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MSbuild\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MSHTA\\\.EXE$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")))
